resolution: Reset the IAM user's MFA device session to force re-synchronization with the hardware token.

resolution: Terminated all active sessions globally and reviewed sign-in logs, confirming it was a false positive triggered by a VPN exit node change.

title: VPN Authentication Failure - Error 691

It keeps throwing 'Error 691: The remote connection was denied because the user name and password combination you provided is not recognized'. resolution: Cleared the browser's persistent storage and updated the SAML assertion settings for the user's profile.

title: Unable to access production database
description: I am getting a 'Permission Denied (publickey)' error when attempting to SSH into the production Linux server (IP: 10.0.4.15). My public key was rotated this morning. Please verify if the new key was added to authorized_keys.
resolution: Found that the public key was uploaded to the staging environment by mistake; corrected the deployment script to target production.

title: Can't access printer
description: The printer in the North wing is saying 'Access Denied' when I try to print from my office PC. It was working fine yesterday.
resolution: Re-added the user to the printer's authorized security group on the Print Server.

title: Urgent: Salesforce access for client demo
description: I have a client demo in 20 minutes and my Salesforce access is completely gone. It says 'User account inactive'. I really need this fixed immediately, please!
resolution: Reactivated the user account which had been flagged by an automated cleanup script for 90 days of inactivity.

title: Issue with MFA prompt
description: My Authenticator app on my iPhone 15 isn't showing the push notification for Microsoft 365 logins. I've restarted the phone and reinstalled the app, but no luck.
resolution: Removed the device from the user's MFA settings in Azure AD and prompted for a re-enrollment flow.

title: GitLab access request
description: Requesting access to the 'mobile-app-frontend' repository for our new intern. They need read-only access to view the codebase.
resolution: Added the user to the 'interns-read-only' GitLab access group.

title: Adobe CC License failure
description: Whenever I launch Photoshop, it tells me I don't have a valid subscription. I'm signed in with my work email, but it keeps redirecting me to the 'Start Trial' page. Is there an issue with the license pool?
resolution: Assigned an available seat from the Adobe Admin Console to the user's email address.

title: Access denied to HR shared drive
description: I transferred from the Marketing department to HR last week, but I still cannot access the 'HR_Records' network drive. My manager said my permissions should have been updated by now.
resolution: Updated the user's Primary Group in Active Directory from 'Marketing_Users' to 'HR_Department_Full'.
